name: Upload the narrated video to YouTube Studio as private
goal: In YouTube Studio, upload the video file, then in the details dialog set the title and the description, choose 'No, it's not made for kids', continue through the steps, set visibility to Private, and click Save (or Done). Finish when the dialog shows that the video is saved or processing is done.

data.title: Almond-fastloop at the Browser Use Olympics
data.description: Almond-fastloop is Almond's browser computer-use rig, built on TypeSafe's decision model. It reads the page through Chrome DevTools and lets Jev pick each action in a quarter of a second. Here it runs the Browser Use Olympics, a five-event benchmark with one server-side clock: 13.4 seconds, five for five, a fifth of a cent. Benchmark: https://sites.almond.build/browser-use-olympics/ Hall of Fame: https://sites.almond.build/browser-use-olympics/hall Code: https://github.com/eriestra/almond-fastloop
